fieldValues.title: Build order for the two-domain walk; srs-rust#1377 proceeds
fieldValues.decision_question: In what order do we build and walk the two domains?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: The order chosen below, with srs-rust#1377 either folded in or held back.
fieldValues.decision_statement: srs-rust#1377 proceeds (ruled 2026-10-09, a generic fork fix, not a process change). Order: (1) clerk method package v1 additions (persona-in-domain, goals, in-domain, held-by description) and the srs-programme upgrade; (2) clerk check-method gate (warn), and roadmap.mjs reading outline clusters and held-by persona-in-domain; (3) srs-web: rebase, review and land #548, add domain and persona-in-domain affirm, buildBoard reads the domain outline, no membership UI; (4) agent data per domain: container and outline, suggested persona-in-domain, re-pointed suggested held-by, then delete contains after readers switch; (5) the owner affirms the domain, then persona-in-domain, and with #1377 all repairs carry the affirmed problems' held-by; (6) the owner removes the old affirmed problem held-by edges to the shared persona. There is no clerk affirm path: the srs-web Method editor is the one affirm UI, with CLI as fallback.
fieldValues.rationale: Each step only depends on earlier ones, and readers switch before any edge is deleted.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Membership UI: when the owner wants to regroup in the editor.
